item.title: 全球伙伴网络
item.summary: A global partner network becomes a strategic control point only when it records and rewards the whole loop from qualified account through partner selection, production acceptance, paid usage, support and renewal. Marketplace reach or partner count alone does not prove repeatable cloud/AI consumption.

synthesis.outlook_12_36m: Programs should converge on outcome-scored partner tiers, shared opportunity telemetry and marketplace economic rails. Advantage will accrue to networks that can expose same-cohort production, renewal and contribution rather than announcements or directory size.
synthesis.strategic_summary: A global partner network becomes a strategic control point only when it records and rewards the whole loop from qualified account through partner selection, production acceptance, paid usage, support and renewal. Marketplace reach or partner count alone does not prove repeatable cloud/AI consumption.
synthesis.why_now: Hyperscalers are moving partner programs toward lifecycle outcomes, AI specialization, private offers and lower marketplace take rates while independent channel evidence reports margin pressure, weaker vendor satisfaction and uneven lead flow.
winner_conditions: Account, opportunity and partner-role identity remains consistent across regions.
Production acceptance, usage, support and renewal are measured on the same cohort.
Marketplace, co-sell and incentive rails preserve partner contribution economics.
Local delivery roles and global security/product responsibilities are explicit.
Partner outcomes and customer outcomes survive independent counterevidence.

evidence.source_quote: Google Cloud Marketplace is moving to a variable revenue share model , with revenue share from 3% to as low as 1.5% for eligible partners and deals based on attributes such as deal size, renewal, channel shift, or migrations. This update will enable partners to improve deal economics and to retain more earnings.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Google exposes marketplace channel-private-offer and variable-revenue-share mechanics that allocate deal economics between platform, ISV and local channel.

evidence.source_quote: Google Cloud Partner Network is being completely streamlined to focus on real-world results. This marks a strategic shift from measuring program work to valuing genuine customer outcomes. This includes rewarding successful co-sell sales efforts, high-quality service delivery, and shared innovation with ISVs. We are also integrating AI into the program’s core to make partner participation much easier, allowing more focus on customers instead of routine program administration.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Google shifts partner rewards from program activity to pre-sales influence, service delivery and post-sales support across the lifecycle.

evidence.source_quote: The real takeaway goes beyond the number; it's about how you can strategically navigate this journey and build towards comprehensive service delivery. Canalys’ research visualizes this through a "partner ecosystem flywheel," which maps typical partner activities across a three-year customer journey. This powerful framework (illustrated below) outlines how leading partners strategically engage customers across six distinct stages: Advise, Design, Procure, Build, Adopt, and Manage .
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: A Google-sponsored Canalys study supplies a lifecycle revenue-multiplier claim; its sponsorship and top-end wording limit cross-player comparison.

evidence.source_quote: The AI opportunity for Google Cloud partners is growing fast. For example, a new study from IDC 1 found that global systems integrators will grow their Google Cloud AI practices as much as 100% this year — and almost half of their Google Cloud AI projects have already moved into widespread production thanks to initial ROI that customers are seeing. It’s clear that much of the opportunity ahead lies in agentic AI — and now, partners are infused at every layer of our AI agent stack.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Google reports agent use-case supply, project production status and funding, but these are vendor-attributed aggregates without consistent cohort economics.

evidence.source_quote: Alibaba Cloud worked with 6Estates’ Technical Team to design and deploy the solution and has provided ongoing support and guidance in the operation of the solution after it went live.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: 6Estates is a real cross-border production case connecting regional compliance, marketplace acquisition, implementation and continuing operations.

evidence.source_quote: Using AWS, STL can now upload about 1 TB of data per vehicle per day and has reduced monthly costs by 40 percent. UMB estimates that it achieved a 40–50 percent increase in operational efficiency by using AWS rather than an on-premises environment. “We implemented the web application in a few days, and now we have good visibility to monitor and act on specific events,” says Roberto Aliano, product manager for cloud services at UMB.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Swiss Transit Lab is a real local AWS-partner production case joining regional compliance, implementation, ongoing monitoring, measurable cost and operating outcomes.

evidence.source_quote: Throughout the year, MSPs publicly criticised Microsoft for failing to protect pricing parity in the CSP ecosystem, allowing large licensing players to undercut smaller partners and then leverage those relationships to capture services revenue. The result, according to many MSPs, is a race to the bottom on licences – followed by awkward conversations about “partner-led growth”.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Independent channel reporting documents CSP pricing parity, thin licensing margin and partner conflict, limiting vendor-reported ecosystem multipliers.

evidence.source_quote: With resale enabled offers , software companies can authorize their channel partners to sell their existing Marketplace offers on their behalf. Software companies start by creating resale enabled offer authorizations in Partner Center. Each authorization is tied to a specific offer, one channel partner, and one or more customer markets that define where the partner can sell. After authorization, channel partners can independently create and sell private offers without further involvement from the software company.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Microsoft documents distinct global channel-led deal constructs and who controls customer pricing, billing and implementation.

evidence.source_quote: Channel Partners are authorized to resale Alibaba Cloud International Site products and solution to end customers. There are three key business models: Agency, Direct Reseller and Distributor.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: The page documents how acquisition, billing, commission and customer support are allocated across Alibaba Cloud international channel models.

evidence.source_quote: Indeed, the proportion of ITSPs describing themselves as “very satisfied” with vendor relationships dropped from 37% last year to just 19% this year, according to GTIA’s State of the Channel 2026 report.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Independent media reports a material fall in partner satisfaction and pricing/licensing friction, countering the assumption that larger partner programs create durable alignment.

evidence.source_quote: Honestly, you getting a lead or a referral is a networking/connections game. The field teams preference for partners is tribal, there is no systematic program to feed partners.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: The discussion challenges the assumption that partner status and directory presence automatically create acquisition flow for smaller firms.

evidence.source_quote: Opportunity collaborated with AIS Partners and Artefact to develop a Microsoft Azure-based AI solution that immediately and accurately answers farmers’ questions in Malawi. Called Ulangizi AI, the chatbot solution provides authoritative information in English and Chichewa by text and voice. Ulangizi, which means “advisor” in Chichewa, is using responsibly developed AI to strengthen Opportunity’s network of farm support agents (FSAs), spread sustainable agriculture practices, and help more farmers overcome extreme poverty.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Opportunity International is a production deployment where two partners localized Microsoft Azure AI for Malawi and embedded it in a field-agent operating network.

evidence.source_quote: According to IDC, for every $1 of Microsoft revenue, services partners earn $8.45, and software partners earn $10.93. This underscores the immense opportunity available to partners of all types. As we look ahead to the future, we know that generative AI (GenAI) is forecast to grow exponentially faster than the overall IT market. Partners generating at least 25% of their Microsoft-related revenue from AI can expect higher margins and revenue growth, unlocking even more potential for transformation and success.*
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Microsoft reports ecosystem scale and AI-oriented partner economics, useful as a vendor-reported reach signal rather than proof of customer-cohort profitability.

evidence.source_quote: Public Oracle Marketplace : The public instance of the Oracle Marketplace is accessible without requiring an OCI account login. This version enables potential customers to explore available solutions before committing to Oracle Cloud. It also serves as a marketing platform for partners to showcase their offerings to a wider audience.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Oracle Marketplace provides a contrasting catalog/procurement archetype with consolidated billing and professional services but no disclosed partner outcome ledger.

evidence.source_quote: Multi-partner co-selling is a key priority for many Partners to accelerate go-to-market. Partners are working together to drive transformative customer outcomes across healthcare, manufacturing, energy, financial services, retail sectors, and more. A 2023 Canalys study shows that 44% of customers rely on multiple partners (4+) to meet their business needs. These relationships deliver significant benefits—improving productivity, reducing costs, enhancing quality, and driving growth.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: AWS documents how multiple partners coordinate on one customer opportunity, while leaving responsibility, renewal and contribution economics undisclosed.
